title: Effect of Breastfeeding Optimization on Early Vascular Development
brief_summary: This study aims to find out whether breast feeding optimization will increase breast feeding rates and to evaluate its effect on cardiovascular risk and general health of children.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria

* Plan to breast feed for ≤2 months
* Residing in vicinity ≤ 5 km from the hospital/agree to comply to health visit schedule
* Telephone communication is possible
* No known HIV or active tuberculosis in mother
* Uncomplicated pregnancy
